sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gunsmith - AKS-74U is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello, mercenary. I need your help. I've been flooded with orders for custom weapon builds, and I simply can't keep up with them all on my own. I could use an extra pair of hands. Interested in making some money? Take this AKS-74U. I need it fitted with a Zenit B-11 handguard, a 60-round extended magazine, ergonomics at least 56, combined recoil below 550, and a sighting range of at least 100. One more thing: it must weigh no more than 3.5 kg and take up no more than 6 slots. That's all. Don't keep me waiting."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Modify an AKS-74U to comply with the given specifications

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.1
- 80,000 Roubles
  - 84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Good. Leave it in the corner, I'll inspect it later."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
AKS-74U specifications:
- 60 Durability
- 56 or greater ergonomics
- Less than 550 recoil
- 100 or greater sighting range
- A magazine with a capacity of at least 60
- 3.5 kg or less in weight
- 6 or fewer cells
- AKS-74U Zenit B-11 handguard

sections.heading: Build
sections.text: This is one example of many possible configurations.

sections.heading: Notes:
sections.text:
- This build is based on a standard AKS-74U. You get one in the mail from Mechanic upon accepting this quest.
- The stock has to be folded.
- The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
